# Test fixtures

- `claude-code-2.1.303-stream.jsonl` and `codex-0.166.0-stream.jsonl` are real CLI
  event streams from the [Orchevia](https://github.com/iazaran/orchevia) project,
  licensed under Apache-2.0, and used unchanged for parser tests.
- `antigravity-docs-stream.jsonl` was written for this project from the event shapes
  in the official Antigravity CLI headless docs. Replace it with a captured `agy`
  stream when one is available.
